name: Kurano-kunchi no Futago Jijou
original_name: 倉野くんちのふたご事情
source:
The 8-person Kurano household that runs the cafe Apple Pie has three sets of twins. The oldest pair is the reliable Izumi and the sporty Mikoto, followed by Kazuya and his tsukkomi-type twin Tomoka. The youngest twins are the Yamato Nadeshiko-like Yae who's great at housework, and the 'so cute you can't help but hug her' Ema. They get along well even if their parents fight constantly. However, one summer day, their parents' arguments had escalated to divorce! His mother gained custody of Kazuya and only one of the 5 daughters. Thus begins the struggle among his sisters to be with the brother that they all love so very much. 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

After storming out of the house their mother allows Kazuya one month to decide which sister will come with him. To make the situation worse the morning after their father leaves for a month on a journey of self discovery. The twins must all work together to keep their parents pastry shop running and Kazuya gets to live alone with all of his sisters!
translation:
经营着“苹果派”咖啡店的仓野一家有八口人，三对双胞胎。最大的一对是可靠的泉和运动型的命，接下来是和也和吐槽担当的双胞胎姐姐知花。最小的双胞胎是擅长家务的大和抚子型的八重，以及“可爱得让人忍不住抱”的绘麻。即使父母经常吵架，他们也相处得很好。然而一个夏日，父母的争吵升级到了离婚的地步！母亲获得了和也以及五个女儿中仅一人的抚养权。姐妹们为能和最爱的哥哥在一起而展开的争夺就此开始。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

母亲夺门而出后给了和也一个月的时间来决定哪个妹妹跟他走。更糟糕的是第二天早上父亲也出门去进行一个月的自我发现之旅。双胞胎们必须合力维持父母的糕点店运营，而和也得以和所有姐妹们独处！
